items: I live in [city]. I have $[amount] to start a business. Suggest 5 practical, low-cost businesses I can launch with only my smartphone, Canva, and free AI tools. For each: the problem it solves, target customers, startup cost, and estimated monthly income.
I am thinking about starting a [type of business]. Ask me 10 questions to clarify my idea, identify my ideal customer, and define my unique value. Then summarize my business concept in 3 sentences.

Help me validate this business idea: [describe]. Is there real demand in my market? Who are my 3 main competitors? Give 3 reasons this could succeed and 3 reasons it could fail — an honest assessment.
Create a complete Business Model Canvas for my [type of business]. Fill in all 9 blocks with specific, realistic examples for my market. Present in a clean table.
Act as my business coach. I want to start a [type of business] in [city]. Ask me 5 questions about my target customers, then help me write a 1-sentence value proposition.
My [business] currently generates $[amount]/month. I want to reach $[target] within 60 days. Analyze my situation and suggest 5 specific strategies to close the gap — with an AI tool to support each.
Review my current approach: [describe business, pricing, platforms]. Identify 3 things to STOP, 3 to START, and 3 to DOUBLE DOWN on.
Suggest 3 complementary products or services I could offer existing customers to increase average order value without significant additional cost.
Help me create a referral program: (1) a message asking existing customers for referrals, (2) the incentive for the referrer, (3) a welcome message for the referred customer.
Write 5 short social posts for my [business] targeting [audience]. Use one technique per post: curiosity, social proof, urgency, education, storytelling. Under 60 words each.
Create a 3-day countdown teaser campaign for my [product/promotion] — one post per day, each building excitement and ending with a call to action. Bilingual EN/FR.
Write 3 closing messages for interested customers who have not yet paid: (1) urgency, (2) social proof, (3) a special limited offer.
Create a 30-day content calendar for my [business]: caption, content type (educational/promo/testimonial/entertainment), posting time, and goal per post. Practical for a solo entrepreneur.
Write a compelling description for [product] that makes someone want to buy immediately: key benefit, price $[amount], social proof, and a direct CTA.

Build a complete SOSTAC plan for my [business]: S — 3 key situation insights; O — 3 SMART objectives; S — my positioning strategy; T — a 2-week tactics calendar; A — a 10-item action checklist; C — 5 KPIs to track weekly.
Analyze the competitive landscape for [type of business] in [city]: top 3 competitors, their pricing, their main channels, their weaknesses, and 3 gaps I could exploit.
Help me price my [product/service]: what competitors charge, what the market can bear, my cost structure — then recommend a 3-tier pricing strategy (basic, standard, premium).
Create a 90-day roadmap in 3 phases: Launch (1–30), Momentum (31–60), Scale (61–90). For each phase give 5 key milestones and the AI tools that help achieve them.

SCENARIO MODELING — You are a senior strategic adviser with 20 years of experience. I am considering [situation]. Map three scenarios — optimistic, realistic, pessimistic — for the next 90 days. For each: top three risks and one specific action for the first 7 days. Be direct and specific.

DEVIL’S ADVOCATE — I am about to [plan/decision]. Act as the most intelligent, well-informed critic of this idea. Identify every significant weakness, hidden risk, false assumption, and alternative I have not considered. Do not soften the critique. Then suggest the top three ways to strengthen the plan.

CHAIN-OF-THOUGHT — Before your final answer, think through this step by step. Show your reasoning at each stage: the information you have, the assumptions you are making, where there is uncertainty. Only then give your recommendation. Question: [your question].

ROLE STACKING — Combine the analytical perspective of a top-tier consultant, the communication instincts of an experienced journalist, and the practical wisdom of an entrepreneur who built with limited resources. From this combined view, review [item] and give your assessment, top three recommendations, and the one thing I am overlooking.

TEAM21 ENGINEER CONSTRUCTION JOURNEY — You are a professional construction project assistant guiding me, a Team21 Engineer, through all phases of designing and estimating a building project: (1) land identification and site analysis, (2) soil and site study with foundation recommendations, (3) building type and style with preliminary sketches, (4) architectural drawings and MEP schematics, (5) 3D visualization, (6) itemized bill of quantities and cost estimate, (7) handover summary with permits and next steps. Move to the next stage only after I provide the required input, and cheer me on at each stage.

TEAM21 LEADERSHIP GROWTH JOURNEY — You are a Leadership Growth AI Mentor guiding me, a Team21 Leader, one question at a time (wait for each answer): my name; my passions, aspirations, legacy, and communities; my talents, gifts and skills; a full SWOT (3 strengths, 3 weaknesses, 3 opportunities, 3 threats); a time-management audit; a life-balance check across Spiritual, Family, Financial, Physical & Mental Health, Social, Educational/Professional, and Personal Development; my three leadership lids; and my engagement with the Team21 3Ps — Pray, Plan, People. Then generate my Leadership Growth Blueprint: mission statement, SWOT interpretation, lid action points, balance overview, and a Personal Growth Plan on the 3Ps — with an optional branded impact graphic tagged Team21 | #LeadLikeJesus, and offer a 30-day or 90-day implementation roadmap.

AI BUSINESS COACH — You are an experienced business mentor with 15 years in my market. Guide me through starting a service business with $[budget] targeting [X]% ROI within 3 months. After each major recommendation, ask me 3 specific questions to ensure I understand before proceeding, and adjust your advice based on my responses and local conditions.
